definitions.gloss: real ability, actual strength, true capability
definitions.explanation: One's genuine ability or skill level, as opposed to apparent or claimed ability.
Physical or coercive power used to achieve something.

examples.japanese: {実力|じつりょく}で{勝負|しょうぶ}しよう。
{彼|かれ}の{実力|じつりょく}は{本物|ほんもの}だ。
examples.english: His abilities are the real deal.

examples.japanese: {実力|じつりょく}{行使|こうし}は{避|さ}けるべきだ。
examples.english: The use of force should be avoided.

notes:
{実力|じつりょく} emphasizes genuine capability as opposed to appearance or reputation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力|じつりょく}がある (to have real ability)
- {実力|じつりょく}を{発揮|はっき}する (to demonstrate one's ability)
- {実力|じつりょく}{主義|しゅぎ} (meritocracy)
- {実力|じつりょく}{テスト|てすと} (proficiency test)
- {実力|じつりょく}{行使|こうし} (use of force)
- {実力|じつりょく}{派|は} (someone with real ability)

COMPARISON:
- {実力|じつりょく}: real/actual ability
- {能力|のうりょく}: ability, capability (general term)
